Roadmap page shell: the chosen design

The design the owner chose from the five mock-ups on 17 November 2026: the title row sticks at the top with a “Jump to” menu, pending changes pin at the foot with “Publish” and “Discard”, “About this roadmap” folds to one line with the family inside it, and a row of links to every placement sits in the page below it. Same invented world as the five mock-ups: Sam Evans's Community Nursing roadmap on Tuesday 17 November 2026. Every frame is a desktop at 1280px and a phone at 375px, labelled with its moment and where keyboard focus is.

Settled over four rounds of grilling and a review (STY-052 D1–D23, STY-053 D1–D8). The header and the phone strip's menu button follow STY-054 and STY-056: the header and phase banner scroll away, the header keeps the language button and an account menu, and a phone's sticky strip starts with the navigation's menu button. STY-054's left-hand navigation is not drawn.
